### Download
| Platform | File |
|----------|------|
| Windows  | `Kathala-*-Setup.exe` |
| macOS    | `Kathala-*.zip` |
| Linux    | `kathala_*.deb` |

### Install
- **Windows**: Run the `.exe` installer
- **macOS**: Unzip and drag Kathala to your Applications folder. On first run, right-click → Open if macOS warns about the developer.
- **Linux**: Install the `.deb` with `sudo dpkg -i kathala_*.deb`

> All data is stored locally on your machine. No account or internet connection required.
